page_title: LOR 0-3 MNT | Lorient v Montpellier 01/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Jeremy Stinat is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+6' Akor Adams (Montpellier) receives a pass and tries his luck with a shot from 35 metres out. Yvon Mvogo pulls off a comfortable save to stop the effort going into the middle of the goal.
90+4' Enzo Tchato (Montpellier) dribbles his way to the edge of the box and drills a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but Yvon Mvogo is equal to the effort and makes a good save.
90+1' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.
89' 0 - 3 Akor Adams (Montpellier) receives a killer pass and scores a great goal after finding the back of the net with a simple finish!
88' Laurent Abergel (Lorient) commits a rough foul. Jeremy Stinat stops the game and makes a call. Montpellier win a free kick.
84' The substitution has been made. Mamadou Sakho (Montpellier) has replaced Maxime Esteve.

83' Julien Laporte (Lorient) makes a good run into the box and unleashes a powerful header in the centre of the box from the corner, but it rises well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Montpellier will have a goal kick.
83' Benjamin Mendy (Lorient) is about to take a corner kick.
80' Igor Silva (Lorient) jumps into a tackle and Jeremy Stinat signals a foul. Montpellier have a free kick.
80' Benjamin Mendy (Lorient) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
79' Romain Faivre (Lorient) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
78' Here comes a substitution. Leo Leroy (Montpellier) is brought on as a substitute for Teji Savanier.
77' The resulting corner, taken by Joel Mvuka Mugisha (Lorient), comes to nothing.
77' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Benjamin Mendy (Lorient). The referee signals a corner kick to Lorient.
76' Substitution. Julien Ponceau will be replaced by Jean-Victor Makengo (Lorient).
75' Benjamin Mendy (Lorient) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.

75' Benjamin Mendy (Lorient) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. The linesman makes the right call and Lorient will have a corner.
73' 0 - 2 Teji Savanier (Montpellier) easily converts the penalty kick as he sends the ball straight into the bottom left corner, ricocheting in off the post. Yvon Mvogo was helpless.
72' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
72' The penalty decision stands after the VAR review. It's a penalty!
72' Wait a minute! The referee has decided to review the penalty decision using the VAR system.

71' Igor Silva (Lorient) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Jeremy Stinat has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Montpellier are given a huge opportunity to score - it's a penalty kick!
68' Julien Laporte (Lorient) whips in a cross from the corner, but Benjamin Lecomte is well positioned and punches the ball away.
64' Enzo Tchato (Montpellier) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Falaye Sacko.
64' Michel Der Zakarian has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Kelvin Yeboah (Montpellier) replacing Wahbi Khazri.
63' Joel Mvuka Mugisha (Lorient) sends a cross into the box, but Benjamin Lecomte comes off his line to gather the ball.
61' Substitution. Eli Junior Kroupi makes his way off the pitch and Sirine Doucoure (Lorient) comes on as his replacement.
61' Maxime Esteve (Montpellier) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.
61' Maxime Esteve (Montpellier) is shown a yellow card by the referee.
60' Benjamin Lecomte makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the left-hand post by Julien Ponceau (Lorient) after a cross from the side.
58' The game has come to an end for Vincent Le Goff. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Benjamin Mendy (Lorient).
58' Here is a change. Gedeon Kalulu is going off and Regis Le Bris gives the last tactical orders to Igor Silva (Lorient).
57' Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
57' Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked. Corner kick. Montpellier will have an opportunity.

52' Romain Faivre (Lorient) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads inside the left post, but Benjamin Lecomte shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.

49' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lorient.
46' Regis Le Bris makes a half-time substitution. Joel Mvuka Mugisha (Lorient) comes on in place of Souleymane Isaak Toure.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' Jeremy Stinat has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.

45+2' Theo Le Bris (Lorient) latches onto a short pass just on the edge of the box and shoots. The effort beats the keeper but comes back off the crossbar. Close! The ball goes out of play and Montpellier will have a goal kick.
45+1' Eli Junior Kroupi (Lorient) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
43' Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
40' Akor Adams (Montpellier) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
39' Eli Junior Kroupi (Lorient) takes the corner.
39' Good defending. Theo Le Bris (Lorient) tries to find Romain Faivre inside the box, but the pass is cut out. The linesman points to the corner flag, Lorient are going to take it.
36' That's unlucky! Eli Junior Kroupi (Lorient) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
34' Montassar Talbi (Lorient) has tested the patience of referee Jeremy Stinat and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
31' 0 - 1 Akor Adams (Montpellier) received a delightful pass inside the box before slotting the ball past the goalkeeper. What a brilliant finish!
30' Romain Faivre (Lorient) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
29' Montpellier enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
24' Akor Adams (Montpellier) passes the ball onto Wahbi Khazri, but one of the defenders dispossesses him.
22' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.

22' That was a nice football moment. Teji Savanier (Montpellier) receives an amazing defence-splitting low pass on the edge of the box and blasts the ball towards the right post. Yvon Mvogo guesses his intention and dives superbly to deny him with a remarkable save! The ball goes behind for a corner. Montpellier will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
20' Julien Ponceau (Lorient) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jeremy Stinat had an easy-decision to make.
16' Eli Junior Kroupi (Lorient) is deemed to be in an offside position by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.

15' What a great chance for Souleymane Isaak Toure (Lorient). He times his jump superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross from the corner, directing his towering header towards the foot of the left post, but the goalkeeper denies him with a miraculous save.
14' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Lorient will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
12' Vincent Le Goff (Lorient) collects a pass on the edge of the box but he slips the ball just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Montpellier.

10' Akor Adams (Montpellier) finds himself some space around the penalty spot and leaps high to meet the free kick. He tries to put his header into the middle of the goal, but Yvon Mvogo keeps it out.
8' The resulting free kick from Teji Savanier (Montpellier) ends up in the gloves of the keeper.
6' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
6' Mousa Al-Tamari receives a sweet cross inside the box from Kiki Kouyate (Montpellier), but one of the defenders rushes in bravely to intercept the ball.

5' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) takes the free kick and sends the ball into the penalty area. The opposition's defence outnumbers the attacking players inside the box and they manage to make a clearance.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! Lorient will take the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Jeremy Stinat.
